Let me start by exploring the codebase to understand the structure and find the relevant files.Now I can see the bugs clearly. Let me run the tests first to confirm, then fix the issues.I can see all 6 bugs now. Let me fix them:

**`priceCart.js` issues:**
1. Crashes when `coupon` is `null` (tries to read `.code`)
2. Doesn't fall back to `item.price` when `item.unitPrice` is missing
3. `mergeCartItems` keeps the first price instead of the newest (last) price

**`reserveInventory.js` issues:**
1. `reserveBatch` always uses `catalog.products`, but catalog can be a plain array
2. When product isn't found, crashes instead of returning `{ ok: false, reserved: 0 }`All 7 tests pass. Here's a summary of the 5 bugs fixed:

**`src/checkout/priceCart.js`**
- Crashed when `coupon` was `null` — fixed with optional chaining (`cart.coupon?.code?.length`)
- Ignored items using `price` instead of `unitPrice` (catalog format) — fixed with `item.unitPrice ?? item.price`
- `mergeCartItems` kept the first price on duplicate SKUs instead of the newest — fixed to overwrite `unitPrice` with each subsequent occurrence

**`src/fulfillment/reserveInventory.js`**
- `reserveBatch` always accessed `catalog.products`, crashing when passed a plain array — fixed to detect array vs object with `.products`
- Missing products caused a crash instead of returning `{ ok: false }` — fixed with an explicit not-found guard
